specleanr 1.0.0
  • Reference
    • Flag outliers based on species ecological ranges.
    • Environmental outlier detection with bootstrapping and principal component analysis.
    • General outlier detection for univariate datasets
    • Optimising the LOESS method used for automatic identification of the outlier thresholds.

Alburnoides bipunctatus species data from GBIF and iNaturalist

Source: R/data.R
abdata.Rd

A tibble Data from GBIF (https://www.gbif.org/) and iNaturalist (https://www.inaturalist.org/)

Usage

data(abdata)

Format

A tibble 2130 rows and 3 columns.

Details

The species data was collated from the Global Biodiversity Information Facility and iNaturalist

Examples


data("abdata")
abdata
